_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bamidbar 4, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses and Aaron, speaking.
translations.2: Raise up the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their clans and their fathers' houses.
translations.3: From thirty years of age and upward, up to fifty years of age — every one who enters the host, to perform a craft in the tent of the assembly.
translations.4: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of the assembly: the choicest of the holy things.
translations.5: And Aaron and his sons shall come in at the setting out of the camp, and they shall take down the concealing veil, and cover with it the ark of the testimony.
translations.6: And they shall place upon it a covering of darash-hides, and spread a cloth wholly of blue over it, and fit its poles.
translations.7: And upon the table of the Presence they shall spread a cloth of blue, and place upon it the dishes and the drawers and the spoons and the flagons for the libation, and the perpetual bread shall be upon it.
translations.8: And they shall spread over them a cloth dyed scarlet, and cover it with a covering of darash-hides, and fit its poles.
translations.9: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover with it the lampstand of light and its lamps, and its tongs and its fire-pans, and all the vessels of its oil with which they tend it.
translations.10: And they shall place it and all its vessels within a covering of darash-hides, and set that upon the carrying-pole.
translations.11: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of darash-hides, and fit its poles.
translations.12: And they shall take all the vessels of service with which they serve in the sanctuary, and place them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of darash-hides, and set them upon the carrying-pole.
translations.13: And they shall clear the ashes from the altar, and spread upon it a cloth of purple.
translations.14: And they shall place upon it all its vessels with which they serve upon it — the fire-pans and the flesh-hooks and the shovels and the basins — and the rest of the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread over it a covering of darash-hides, and fit its carrying-poles.
translations.15: And when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all its vessels at the setting out of the camp, then after that those of them who are counted — the sons of Kohath — shall come in and carry them; but they shall not approach the holy things, lest they be destroyed. This is the description of the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of the assembly.
translations.16: And the charge of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest is the oil of the light, and the incense of resins, and the perpetual grain-offering and the oil of anointing — that is the charge of the tabernacle and all that is in it, of holy things and its vessels.
translations.17: Then God spoke to Moses and Aaron, speaking.
translations.18: Do not cut off the clans of the tribe of Kohath from among the Levites.
translations.19: But do this for them as a remedy, so that they may live and not be destroyed by their approaching the choicest of the holy things: Aaron and his sons shall come in and assign them, each group to its service and its burden.
translations.20: And they shall not come in and look at the time of the covering of the holy things, lest they be destroyed.
translations.21: Then God spoke to Moses, speaking.
translations.22: Raise up the sum of the sons of Gershon — they too — by their fathers' houses and by their clans.
translations.23: From thirty years of age and upward, up to fifty years of age, you shall count them — every one who enters the host for service in the tent of the assembly.
translations.24: And this is their service — labor and burden.
translations.25: They shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tent of the assembly, its covering, and the covering of darash-hide that is upon it from above, and the screen of the entrance of the tent of the assembly,
translations.26: and the hangings of the enclosure and the screen of its entrance, which is around the tabernacle and the altar, and their cords, and the rest of the vessels of its service — and everything that pertains to them, they shall serve.
translations.27: At the word of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of Gershon, both their burden and the rest of their labor; and you shall register upon them in keeping all their burden.
translations.28: This is the service of the clans of the sons of Gershon in the tent of the assembly, and their charge, under the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
translations.29: The sons of Merari, by their clans and their fathers' houses, you shall count them.
translations.30: From thirty years of age and upward, up to fifty years of age, you shall count them — every one who enters the host for service in the tent of the assembly.
translations.31: And this is the charge of their burden, and the rest of their labor in the tent of the assembly: the planks of the tabernacle, and its bars and its pillars and its bases,
translations.32: and the pillars of the enclosure all around, and their bases and their pegs and their cords, and all their vessels, and the rest of their works; and you shall register by name all the vessels of the charge of their burden.
translations.33: This is the service of the sons of Merari in the tent of the assembly, under the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
translations.34: And Moses and Aaron and the nobles of the congregation counted the sons of Kohath, by their clans and their fathers' houses,
translations.35: from thirty years of age and upward, up to fifty years of age — every one who enters the host for service in the tent of the assembly.
translations.36: And their count by their clans was two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
translations.37: These are the counts of the clans of the Kohathites — all who serve in the tent of the assembly — whom Moses and Aaron counted by the command of God, by the hand of Moses.
translations.38: And the count of the sons of Gershon, by their clans and their fathers' houses,
translations.39: from thirty years of age and upward, up to fifty years of age — every one who enters the host for service in the tent of the assembly.
translations.40: Their count by their clans and their fathers' houses was two thousand six hundred and thirty.
translations.41: These are the counted ones of the clans of the sons of Gershon — all who serve in the tent of the assembly — whom Moses and Aaron counted by the word of God.
translations.42: And the count of the clans of the sons of Merari, by their clans and their fathers' houses,
translations.43: from thirty years of age and upward, up to fifty years of age — every one who enters the host for service in the tent of the assembly.
translations.44: And their count by their clans was three thousand two hundred.
translations.45: These are the counted ones of the clans of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted by the command of God, by the hand of Moses.
translations.46: All those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron and the nobles of the sons of Israel counted — the Levites — by their clans and their fathers' houses,
translations.47: from thirty years of age and upward, up to fifty years of age — every one who enters to serve the service of labor and the service of burden in the tent of the assembly.
translations.48: And their count was eight thousand five hundred and eighty.
translations.49: By the command of God Moses counted them, each group in its labor and its burden, and its number — as God commanded Moses.
